fact: The Ministry of Education's Eritrea: Basic Education Statistics 2023/24, the 26th annual report, draws on one administrative source, the annual school censuses carried out by the Zoba education offices through standard questionnaires (school returns), and covers early childhood, elementary, middle and secondary education.
title: Eritrea: Basic Education Statistics 2023/24
publisher: Ministry of Education, Eritrea (reposted by Eritrean Center for Strategic Studies)
